purpose: Bounded cross-video representation/baseline feasibility while M1 is BLOCKED_FRONTEND_QUALITY
category_allowlist: Inherited Known IDs only; original Known/Novel roles are not redefined
selection_rule: Reserve first four sorted Known categories with >=10 long-track videos; first four other sorted >=3-video categories are policy_train pseudo-Novel, next four are heldout_selection pseudo-Novel. Allocate pseudo-Novel categories in ascending (video support, category ID), selecting first available videos; then allocate four supported Known categories in sorted order to representation(4), policy_train(3), heldout_selection(3) videos. Videos may be shared only within the same partition. First eligible sorted physical track and first 16 chronological observations.
source_bias: Small deterministic long-track GT subset; perfect physical coverage, unit GT quality; not representative of predicted track failures
feature_precision: Same pinned frozen DINOv2 FP32 inference / FP16 compact storage as prior GT smoke
baseline_scope: B0 frame nearest voting, B1 recovered nearest prototype, B2 recovered DP-Means; B3 unavailable checkpoint INCOMPARABLE
prototype_supervision: Same four legal Train Known classes and same separate prototype tracks for all comparable methods
